name: codex-bakeoff
description: Run a Codex bakeoff from an external-browser controller.

interface.shortDescription: Run a bakeoff entirely in your external browser.
interface.longDescription: Open an external-browser controller to select one imported historical Claude thread, choose a Codex model, define the beginning and end states, approve one native Codex implementation, follow live progress, and review the blinded comparison. Selection, execution, verification, evaluation, and results stay in the controller instead of a guided chat workflow.
defaultPrompt: Open the Codex Bakeoff controller in my external browser.
Open the external-browser controller so I can select and run a historical bakeoff.
Open the external-browser controller so I can review my bakeoff runs.
